summary: Talos Energy Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its indirect subsidiary Talos Ocho Energy LLC, together with an affiliate of Ridgewood Energy Corporation, entered into a purchase agreement with Shell Offshore Inc. to acquire deepwater oil and gas assets in the Gulf of America for $1.7 billion in cash. Each buyer will acquire a 50% undivided interest, with Talos gaining operatorship of the Coulomb field and a 25% working interest in the BP-operated Na Kika platform. The deal has a July 1, 2025, economic effective date and is subject to BP's preferential right to purchase certain interests within 30 days. Watch for BP's decision and regulatory clearance for risk-arb.
